query: For condition eras of back pain (SNOMED concept code 161891005, 'Backache') or any of its descendant concepts, what are the minimum, maximum and average era length in days (end date minus start date)?
description: For condition eras of back pain (SNOMED concept code 161891005, 'Backache') or any of its descendant concepts, what are the minimum, maximum and average era length in days (end date minus start date)?
sql_query: SELECT MIN(date_diff('day', ce.condition_era_start_date, ce.condition_era_end_date)) AS min_days, MAX(date_diff('day', ce.condition_era_start_date, ce.condition_era_end_date)) AS max_days, AVG(date_diff('day', ce.condition_era_start_date, ce.condition_era_end_date)) AS avg_days FROM cdm.condition_era ce JOIN cdm.concept_ancestor ca ON ca.descendant_concept_id = ce.condition_concept_id JOIN cdm.concept c ON c.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id WHERE c.vocabulary_id = 'SNOMED' AND c.concept_code = '161891005'
response:
From(:condition_era) |>
Join(:ca => From(:concept_ancestor), Get.condition_concept_id .== Get.ca.descendant_concept_id) |>
Join(:c => From(:concept), Get.ca.ancestor_concept_id .== Get.c.concept_id) |>
Where(Fun.and(Get.c.vocabulary_id .== "SNOMED", Get.c.concept_code .== "161891005")) |>
Define(:days => Fun.date_diff("day", Get.condition_era_start_date, Get.condition_era_end_date)) |>
Group() |>
Select(:min_days => Agg.min(Get.days), :max_days => Agg.max(Get.days), :avg_days => Agg.avg(Get.days))

sql_query: WITH t2d AS ( SELECT ce.person_id, MIN(ce.condition_era_start_date) AS diagnosis_date FROM cdm.condition_era ce JOIN cdm.observation_period op ON op.person_id = ce.person_id AND ce.condition_era_start_date >= op.observation_period_start_date + INTERVAL 180 DAY AND ce.condition_era_start_date <= op.observation_period_end_date - INTERVAL 180 DAY WHERE ce.condition_concept_id = 201826 GROUP BY ce.person_id) SELECT c.concept_name AS ingredient_name, de.drug_concept_id AS ingredient_concept_id, COUNT(*) AS num_eras, MIN(date_diff('day', de.drug_era_start_date, de.drug_era_end_date) + 1) AS min_length_of_therapy, MAX(date_diff('day', de.drug_era_start_date, de.drug_era_end_date) + 1) AS max_length_of_therapy, AVG(date_diff('day', de.drug_era_start_date, de.drug_era_end_date) + 1) AS average_length_of_therapy FROM t2d JOIN cdm.drug_era de ON de.person_id = t2d.person_id AND de.drug_era_start_date >= t2d.diagnosis_date AND de.drug_era_start_date <= t2d.diagnosis_date + INTERVAL 30 DAY JOIN cdm.concept c ON c.concept_id = de.drug_concept_id GROUP BY c.concept_name, de.drug_concept_id
response:
From(:t2d) |>
Join(:de => From(:drug_era),
     Fun.and(Get.person_id .== Get.de.person_id,
             Get.de.drug_era_start_date .>= Get.diagnosis_date,
             Get.de.drug_era_start_date .<= Fun("? + INTERVAL 30 DAY", Get.diagnosis_date))) |>
Join(:c => From(:concept), Get.de.drug_concept_id .== Get.c.concept_id) |>
Define(:length_of_therapy => Fun.date_diff("day", Get.de.drug_era_start_date, Get.de.drug_era_end_date) .+ 1) |>
Group(:ingredient_name => Get.c.concept_name, :ingredient_concept_id => Get.de.drug_concept_id) |>
Select(Get.ingredient_name, Get.ingredient_concept_id, :num_eras => Agg.count(),
       :min_length_of_therapy => Agg.min(Get.length_of_therapy),
       :max_length_of_therapy => Agg.max(Get.length_of_therapy),
       :average_length_of_therapy => Agg.avg(Get.length_of_therapy)) |>
With(:t2d =>
    From(:condition_era) |>
    Where(Get.condition_concept_id .== 201826) |>
    Join(:op => From(:observation_period),
         Fun.and(Get.person_id .== Get.op.person_id,
                 Get.condition_era_start_date .>= Fun("? + INTERVAL 180 DAY", Get.op.observation_period_start_date),
                 Get.condition_era_start_date .<= Fun("? - INTERVAL 180 DAY", Get.op.observation_period_end_date))) |>
    Group(Get.person_id) |>
    Select(Get.person_id, :diagnosis_date => Agg.min(Get.condition_era_start_date)))

description: Take each patient's first condition era of myocardial infarction (concept 4329847 or any descendant) as their diagnosis date. How many patients were diagnosed, and how many of them died within 360 days after the diagnosis date (death_date <= diagnosis date + 360 days)?

response:
From(:condition_era) |>
Where(Fun.and(Get.condition_concept_id .== 4132891,
              Get.condition_era_start_date .> Fun.cast("2011-01-01", "DATE"))) |>
LeftJoin(:de => From(:drug_era) |> Where(Fun.in(Get.drug_concept_id, 1174888, 1124957, 1177480, 1115008)),
         Fun.and(Get.person_id .== Get.de.person_id,
                 Get.de.drug_era_start_date .>= Get.condition_era_start_date,
                 Get.de.drug_era_start_date .<= Fun("? + INTERVAL 60 DAY", Get.condition_era_start_date))) |>
Group(Get.person_id, Get.condition_era_start_date, Get.condition_era_end_date) |>
Select(:condition_days => Fun.date_diff("day", Get.condition_era_start_date, Get.condition_era_end_date),
       :opioid => Agg.max(Fun.case(Fun.in(Get.de.drug_concept_id, 1174888, 1124957), 1, 0)),
       :nsaid => Agg.max(Fun.case(Fun.in(Get.de.drug_concept_id, 1177480, 1115008), 1, 0))) |>
Group(:treatment => Fun.case(Get.opioid .== 1, "Opioid", Get.nsaid .== 1, "NSAID", "No Treatment")) |>
Select(Get.treatment, :n_eras => Agg.count(), :min_days => Agg.min(Get.condition_days),
       :max_days => Agg.max(Get.condition_days), :avg_condition_days => Agg.avg(Get.condition_days))

query: Search for condition concepts by keyword: find valid SNOMED concepts of class 'Clinical Finding' whose name or any of whose synonyms contains 'myocardial infarction' (case-insensitive). Return each distinct concept's id, name, code, class and vocabulary.
description: Search for condition concepts by keyword: find valid SNOMED concepts of class 'Clinical Finding' whose name or any of whose synonyms contains 'myocardial infarction' (case-insensitive). Return each distinct concept's id, name, code, class and vocabulary.
sql_query: SELECT DISTINCT c.concept_id AS entity_concept_id, c.concept_name AS entity_name, c.concept_code AS entity_code, c.concept_class_id AS entity_concept_class, c.vocabulary_id AS entity_vocabulary_id FROM cdm.concept c LEFT JOIN cdm.concept_synonym s ON s.concept_id = c.concept_id WHERE c.invalid_reason IS NULL AND c.vocabulary_id = 'SNOMED' AND c.concept_class_id = 'Clinical Finding' AND (lower(c.concept_name) LIKE '%myocardial infarction%' OR lower(s.concept_synonym_name) LIKE '%myocardial infarction%')
response:

LeftJoin(:s => From(:concept_synonym), Get.concept_id .== Get.s.concept_id) |>
Where(Fun.or(Fun.like(Fun.lower(Get.concept_name), "%myocardial infarction%"),
             Fun.like(Fun.lower(Get.s.concept_synonym_name), "%myocardial infarction%"))) |>
Group(:entity_concept_id => Get.concept_id, :entity_name => Get.concept_name, :entity_code => Get.concept_code,

For standard drug concepts that descend from the ingredient acetaminophen (1125315), follow any relationship to a concept of class 'Dose Form' and count per dose form name. Give each form's share as a percentage of the total.
sql_query: SELECT form_name, 100.0 * cn / SUM(cn) OVER () AS percent_forms FROM (SELECT drugform.concept_name AS form_name, COUNT(*) AS cn FROM cdm.concept ingredient JOIN cdm.concept_ancestor a ON ingredient.concept_id = a.ancestor_concept_id JOIN cdm.concept drug ON a.descendant_concept_id = drug.concept_id JOIN cdm.concept_relationship r ON drug.concept_id = r.concept_id_1 JOIN cdm.concept drugform ON r.concept_id_2 = drugform.concept_id WHERE ingredient.concept_id = 1125315 AND ingredient.concept_class_id = 'Ingredient' AND drug.standard_concept = 'S' AND drugform.concept_class_id = 'Dose Form' GROUP BY drugform.concept_name) t
response:
From(:concept) |>
Where(Fun.and(Get.concept_id .== 1125315, Get.concept_class_id .== "Ingredient")) |>
Join(:a => From(:concept_ancestor), Get.concept_id .== Get.a.ancestor_concept_id) |>
Join(:drug => From(:concept), Get.a.descendant_concept_id .== Get.drug.concept_id) |>
Where(Get.drug.standard_concept .== "S") |>
Join(:r => From(:concept_relationship), Get.drug.concept_id .== Get.r.concept_id_1) |>
Join(:drugform => From(:concept), Get.r.concept_id_2 .== Get.drugform.concept_id) |>
Where(Get.drugform.concept_class_id .== "Dose Form") |>
Group(:form_name => Get.drugform.concept_name) |>
Select(Get.form_name, :cn => Agg.count()) |>
Partition() |>
Select(Get.form_name, :percent_forms => 100.0 .* Get.cn ./ Agg.sum(Get.cn))

query: Take each person's first drug exposure to any drug descending from simvastatin (ingredient 1539403) as their index date. Among them, keep those with an observation period that starts more than 180 days before the index date and ends more than 365 days after it. Count these persons by whole years of follow-up: floor(days from index date to observation period end / 365).
description: Take each person's first drug exposure to any drug descending from simvastatin (ingredient 1539403) as their index date. Among them, keep those with an observation period that starts more than 180 days before the index date and ends more than 365 days after it. Count these persons by whole years of follow-up: floor(days from index date to observation period end / 365).
sql_query: WITH statin_users AS ( SELECT de.person_id, MIN(de.drug_exposure_start_date) AS index_date FROM cdm.drug_exposure de JOIN cdm.concept_ancestor ca ON ca.descendant_concept_id = de.drug_concept_id WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id = 1539403 GROUP BY de.person_id) SELECT floor(date_diff('day', su.index_date, op.observation_period_end_date) / 365) AS follow_up_years, COUNT(*) AS persons FROM statin_users su JOIN cdm.observation_period op ON op.person_id = su.person_id WHERE op.observation_period_start_date + INTERVAL 180 DAY < su.index_date AND op.observation_period_end_date > su.index_date + INTERVAL 365 DAY GROUP BY follow_up_years
response:
From(:drug_exposure) |>
Join(:ca => From(:concept_ancestor), Get.drug_concept_id .== Get.ca.descendant_concept_id) |>
Where(Get.ca.ancestor_concept_id .== 1539403) |>
Group(Get.person_id) |>
Select(Get.person_id, :index_date => Agg.min(Get.drug_exposure_start_date)) |>
Join(:op => From(:observation_period), Get.person_id .== Get.op.person_id) |>
Where(Fun.and(Fun("? + INTERVAL 180 DAY", Get.op.observation_period_start_date) .< Get.index_date,
              Get.op.observation_period_end_date .> Fun("? + INTERVAL 365 DAY", Get.index_date))) |>
Group(:follow_up_years => Fun.floor(Fun.date_diff("day", Get.index_date, Get.op.observation_period_end_date) ./ 365)) |>
Select(Get.follow_up_years, :persons => Agg.count())

query: What is the adherence rate for lisinopril (ingredient 1308216)? For lisinopril drug eras longer than 100 days (end minus start), sum the days_supply of the person's lisinopril exposures (drugs descending from the ingredient, with days_supply > 0) that start within the era. Adherence is that sum divided by the era length in days. Report the number of eras, the average era length, and the average adherence.
description: What is the adherence rate for lisinopril (ingredient 1308216)? For lisinopril drug eras longer than 100 days (end minus start), sum the days_supply of the person's lisinopril exposures (drugs descending from the ingredient, with days_supply > 0) that start within the era. Adherence is that sum divided by the era length in days. Report the number of eras, the average era length, and the average adherence.
sql_query: WITH eras AS ( SELECT de.person_id, de.drug_era_start_date, date_diff('day', de.drug_era_start_date, de.drug_era_end_date) AS treatment_length, SUM(dx.days_supply) AS days_supply FROM cdm.drug_era de JOIN cdm.drug_exposure dx ON dx.person_id = de.person_id AND dx.drug_exposure_start_date >= de.drug_era_start_date AND dx.drug_exposure_start_date <= de.drug_era_end_date JOIN cdm.concept_ancestor ca ON ca.descendant_concept_id = dx.drug_concept_id AND ca.ancestor_concept_id = 1308216 WHERE de.drug_concept_id = 1308216 AND dx.days_supply > 0 AND date_diff('day', de.drug_era_start_date, de.drug_era_end_date) > 100 GROUP BY de.person_id, de.drug_era_start_date, de.drug_era_end_date) SELECT COUNT(*) AS number_of_eras, AVG(treatment_length) AS average_treatment_length, AVG(1.0 * days_supply / treatment_length) AS average_adherence FROM eras
response:
From(:drug_era) |>
Where(Fun.and(Get.drug_concept_id .== 1308216,
              Fun.date_diff("day", Get.drug_era_start_date, Get.drug_era_end_date) .> 100)) |>
Join(:dx => From(:drug_exposure) |> Where(Get.days_supply .> 0),
     Fun.and(Get.person_id .== Get.dx.person_id,
             Get.dx.drug_exposure_start_date .>= Get.drug_era_start_date,
             Get.dx.drug_exposure_start_date .<= Get.drug_era_end_date)) |>
Join(:ca => From(:concept_ancestor),
     Fun.and(Get.dx.drug_concept_id .== Get.ca.descendant_concept_id, Get.ca.ancestor_concept_id .== 1308216)) |>
Group(Get.person_id, Get.drug_era_start_date, Get.drug_era_end_date) |>
Select(:treatment_length => Fun.date_diff("day", Get.drug_era_start_date, Get.drug_era_end_date),
       :days_supply => Agg.sum(Get.dx.days_supply)) |>
Group() |>
Select(:number_of_eras => Agg.count(), :average_treatment_length => Agg.avg(Get.treatment_length),
       :average_adherence => Agg.avg(1.0 .* Get.days_supply ./ Get.treatment_length))

response:
From(:payer_plan_period) |>
Group(Get.plan_source_value) |>
Select(Get.plan_source_value, :n => Agg.count()) |>
Partition() |>
Select(Get.plan_source_value, :num_patients => Get.n, :perc_of_total_count => 100.0 .* Get.n ./ Agg.sum(Get.n))

query: How many female patients (gender_concept_id 8532) are in the person table?
description: How many female patients (gender_concept_id 8532) are in the person table?

Select(:num_persons => Agg.count(Get.person_id))

query: Count the persons per gender: gender_concept_id, gender concept name and number of persons.
description: Count the persons per gender: gender_concept_id, gender concept name and number of persons.
sql_query: SELECT p.gender_concept_id, c.concept_name AS gender_name, COUNT(p.person_id) AS num_persons FROM cdm.person p JOIN cdm.concept c ON p.gender_concept_id = c.concept_id GROUP BY p.gender_concept_id, c.concept_name
response:
From(:person) |>
Join(:c => From(:concept), Get.gender_concept_id .== Get.c.concept_id) |>
Group(Get.gender_concept_id, :gender_name => Get.c.concept_name) |>
Select(Get.gender_concept_id, Get.gender_name, :num_persons => Agg.count())

query: Summarise year of birth across all persons: the 25th percentile, median and 75th percentile (quantile_disc), the minimum, the maximum, and the mean rounded down to an integer.
description: Summarise year of birth across all persons: the 25th percentile, median and 75th percentile (quantile_disc), the minimum, the maximum, and the mean rounded down to an integer.
sql_query: SELECT quantile_disc(year_of_birth, 0.25) AS percentile_25, quantile_disc(year_of_birth, 0.5) AS median, quantile_disc(year_of_birth, 0.75) AS percentile_75, MIN(year_of_birth) AS minimum, MAX(year_of_birth) AS maximum, floor(AVG(year_of_birth)) AS mean FROM cdm.person
response:
From(:person) |>
Group() |>
Select(:percentile_25 => Agg.quantile_disc(Get.year_of_birth, 0.25), :median => Agg.quantile_disc(Get.year_of_birth, 0.5),
       :percentile_75 => Agg.quantile_disc(Get.year_of_birth, 0.75), :minimum => Agg.min(Get.year_of_birth),
       :maximum => Agg.max(Get.year_of_birth), :mean => Fun.floor(Agg.avg(Get.year_of_birth)))

query: Search procedures by keyword: find standard concepts in the Procedure domain (vocabularies SNOMED, ICD9Proc, ICD10PCS, CPT4, HCPCS) whose name or any synonym (lowercased) contains 'fixation of fracture'. Return each distinct concept's id, name, code, class and vocabulary.
description: Search procedures by keyword: find standard concepts in the Procedure domain (vocabularies SNOMED, ICD9Proc, ICD10PCS, CPT4, HCPCS) whose name or any synonym (lowercased) contains 'fixation of fracture'. Return each distinct concept's id, name, code, class and vocabulary.
sql_query: SELECT DISTINCT c.concept_id AS entity_concept_id, c.concept_name AS entity_name, c.concept_code AS entity_code, c.concept_class_id AS entity_concept_class_id, c.vocabulary_id AS entity_vocabulary_id FROM cdm.concept c LEFT JOIN cdm.concept_synonym s ON c.concept_id = s.concept_id WHERE c.vocabulary_id IN ('SNOMED', 'ICD9Proc', 'ICD10PCS', 'CPT4', 'HCPCS') AND c.domain_id = 'Procedure' AND c.standard_concept = 'S' AND (lower(c.concept_name) LIKE '%fixation of fracture%' OR lower(s.concept_synonym_name) LIKE '%fixation of fracture%')
response:
From(:concept) |>
Where(Fun.and(Fun.in(Get.vocabulary_id, "SNOMED", "ICD9Proc", "ICD10PCS", "CPT4", "HCPCS"),
              Get.domain_id .== "Procedure", Get.standard_concept .== "S")) |>
LeftJoin(:s => From(:concept_synonym), Get.concept_id .== Get.s.concept_id) |>
Where(Fun.or(Fun.like(Fun.lower(Get.concept_name), "%fixation of fracture%"),
             Fun.like(Fun.lower(Get.s.concept_synonym_name), "%fixation of fracture%"))) |>
Group(:entity_concept_id => Get.concept_id, :entity_name => Get.concept_name, :entity_code => Get.concept_code,
      :entity_concept_class_id => Get.concept_class_id, :entity_vocabulary_id => Get.vocabulary_id) |>
Select(Get.entity_concept_id, Get.entity_name, Get.entity_code, Get.entity_concept_class_id, Get.entity_vocabulary_id)
